stem: What is the most likely reason schools are offering individual sports such as hip-hop dance, kickboxing, and Dance Dance Revolution?

options.label: A
options.text: They provide more benefits than traditional forms of exercise.

options.label: B
options.text: They appeal more to young people looking for fun activities.

options.label: C
options.text: They are more widely available with school settings.

options.label: D
options.text: They require less training and thus are easier to perform.
